verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents evaluating feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers (docs-14). It also offers a self-hosted Proxy that caches SDK payloads close to the app, cuts latency, and keeps serving flags if the API is down (docs-11, docs-45). A founder comment adds that a single cacheable JSON definition is evaluated locally in the SDKs (comm-6), which suits edge delivery. Missing for 10: evidence of edge support beyond Cloudflare Workers (e.g., other CDN or edge runtimes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the edge integration.
